#include <string>

int main() {
    std::string s;
    std::cin >> s;
    int n = s.length();
    int insertions = 0;
    int i = 0;
    while (i < n) {
        int j = i;
        while (j < n && s[j] == s[i]) {
            j++;
        }
        int runLength = j - i;
        if (runLength % 2 == 0) {
            insertions++;
        }
        i = j;
    }
    std::cout << insertions << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
